abstract: Maintains contracted hotel room allocations and visitor accommodation capacity
system_message:
You are the Delegate Hospitality Bureau Head (HOSP), responsible for maintaining contracted hotel room allocations and visitor accommodation capacity.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains contracted hotel room allocations and visitor accommodation capacity（ACCOM）
information_points.content:
HOSP-ACCOM-YWR：At the Danube Waterfront Arena, contracted adjacent delegate hotel rooms total 750 rooms held exclusively for accredited expo delegates across four-star and five-star partner properties within a 1.5 km pedestrian radius.
HOSP-ACCOM-GNT：The Rhine-Ruhr Expo Pavilion features 600 contracted adjacent delegate hotel rooms secured as a guaranteed block in four-star and five-star partner hotels situated within a 1.5 km pedestrian radius.
HOSP-ACCOM-E36：For the Bavaria International Congress Center, the guaranteed block reserved exclusively for accredited expo delegates across four-star and five-star hotels within a 1.5 km pedestrian radius of the venue stands at 450 contracted adjacent delegate hotel rooms.

information_points.title: Banqueting kitchen throughput（MEAL）
information_points.content:
HOSP-MEAL-TL6：The central exhibition banquet preparation kitchen at the Rhine-Ruhr Expo Pavilion provides a concurrent banquet meal service capacity of 2,000 meals plated and served hot within a 90-minute window.
HOSP-MEAL-PBN：Audits of the Danube Waterfront Arena central banquet kitchen confirm a concurrent banquet meal service capacity of 3,000 meals plated and served concurrently within a 90-minute service window.
HOSP-MEAL-D6X：According to the central exhibition banquet preparation kitchen inspection audit, the Bavaria International Congress Center maintains a concurrent banquet meal service capacity of 4,000 meals plated and served hot within a 90-minute window.
